docs.title: flexlayout
docs.text:
Custom map for the highcharter package.

Info

This package was funded by The Association of State and Territorial Health Officials

This product was supported by OE22-2203: Strengthening U.S. Public Health Infrastructure, Workforce, and Data Systems grant Number 6 NE11OE000066, funded by CDC. Its contents are solely the responsibility of the authors and do not necessarily represent the official views of CDC.

The custom.map package is used the Astho’s Profile dashboard that was presented at the Shinconf 2024.

docs.title: Get Started
docs.text:
Run the snippets below to see some examples.

highcharter::highchart(type = "map") |> 
  hc_add_custom_map(data = test_data, joinBy = "fips", value = "value", mapType = "c") |>
  highcharter::hc_colorAxis(min = 4600)


highcharter::highchart(type = "map") |> 
  hc_add_custom_map(data = test_data, joinBy = "fips", value = "value", mapType = "a") |>
  highcharter::hc_colorAxis(min = 4600)

highcharter::highchart(type = "map") |> 
  hc_add_custom_map(data = test_data, joinBy = "fips", value = "value", mapType = "b") |>
  highcharter::hc_colorAxis(min = 4600)

data <- test_data
data$categories <- sample(LETTERS[1:3], nrow(data), replace = TRUE)

highcharter::highchart(type = "map") |> 
  hc_add_custom_map_cat(data = data, joinBy = "fips", value = "categories") |>
  highcharter::hc_colorAxis(
    dataClasses = list(
      list(
        from = "A",
        to = "A",
        name = "A"
      ),
      list(
        from = "B",
        to = "B",
        name = "B"
      ),
      list(
        from = "C",
        to = "C",
        name = "C"
      )
    )
  )

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
custom.map is not yet on CRAN, you can get it from Github.

Using remotes

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("the-y-company/custom.map")

Using pak

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("the-y-company/custom.map")
